_note: feed slug -> Pinterest board. Each feed URL https://characternamehub.com/pin-feeds/<slug>.xml is connected to its board in Pinterest Settings > Import content > Auto-publish. Pinterest refuses to connect an empty feed, so every feed here must keep at least one item.

dragon-names.use_for: dragons of any kind (Chinese, Japanese, elemental, colored dragons, wyverns, drakes) - not Dragonborn, not Dragon Age

pokemon-names.use_for: Pokemon tools only (nicknames, trainers, towns, regions, random Pokemon)

fantasy-character-names.use_for: fantasy races, classes and characters: elves, dwarves, orcs, tieflings, witches, paladins, vampires, angels, demons, heroes, warriors...

fantasy-creature-names.use_for: monsters, beasts and mythical creatures: werewolves/lycans, gargoyles, kaiju, griffins, unicorns, wendigos, fantasy animals and pets

fantasy-place-names.use_for: kingdoms, cities, towns, taverns, guilds, clans, covens, cults, ships, starships, planets, worlds

game-anime-names.use_for: video game, anime, sci-fi franchise, username/gamertag and pop-culture generators, mechs, titles and other ideas
